claim: AWS Network Firewall logs can be natively stored in Amazon S3, Amazon Data Firehose (formerly Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose) and Amazon CloudWatch, and you can use the same or a different logging destination for each log type.

evidence.quote: You can use the same or different logging destination for each log type.
AWS Network Firewall logs can be natively stored in Amazon S3, Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose, and Amazon CloudWatch.

note: d093. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: the destination names come from the FAQ (it uses the former name Kinesis Data Firehose); the guide's destination topic titles are links and cannot be quoted.
